#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""UL v15: self-contained obligation/certificate data checks, not proof checking."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, re, copy

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
DATA_PATH=ROOT/'dataset.json'

class GateError(ValueError):pass

def canonical(obj):
    return json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode('utf-8')

def digest(obj):return hashlib.sha256(canonical(obj)).hexdigest()

def load():return json.loads(DATA_PATH.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))

ACCEPT={'primary','supporting','reviewed','refuted','conjecture','candidate','excluded'}
PROOF={'none','bundle_only','side_conditions_open','certificate_attached','checker_passed','independently_reproduced'}
IMPORT={'unvalidated','metadata_validated','scope_validated','independently_certified'}
SHA=re.compile(r'^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

# --- v2 baseline-bound link-migration guard (Claude 01Cz proposal; identical to migration_guard.py) ---
ORIGINAL_EDGE_COUNT = 108
ORIGINAL_EDGE_SHA256 = 'e1c88cde4b04493170e74c58128f10a85c7c7961bf1daef6ef0f228d2fecd959'
AUTHORIZED_MIGRATION = {'id': 'MIG-P15-T1-PREMISE-T2-20261025', 'obligation': 'OBL:P15-T1',
                        'added_premise': 'P15-T2', 'link_count_before': 108, 'link_count_after': 109}
ALLOWED_MIGRATION_STATUS = {'PROPOSED_NOT_ADOPTED', 'ADOPTED_AFTER_REVIEW'}
SUCCESSOR_EDGE_SHA256 = 'bdd2ea04a24ced3fad835ca09a7bb3ed9b8608fbf02b044098f80e5c68f87523'

def _edge_digest(obs):
    edges = sorted([n, p] for n, o in obs.items() for p in o['premises'])
    return len(edges), hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(edges, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True,
                                                 separators=(',', ':')).encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()

def check_link_migration(data, obs, err):
    migs = data.get('metadata', {}).get('documented_link_migrations', [])
    count, digest = _edge_digest(obs)
    if not migs:
        # unchanged original rule for an unmigrated dataset
        if count != ORIGINAL_EDGE_COUNT: raise err('proof link count changed without documented migration')
        return
    if len(migs) != 1: raise err('only the single authorized link migration is permitted')
    m = migs[0]
    if any(m.get(k) != v for k, v in AUTHORIZED_MIGRATION.items()): raise err('unauthorized link migration')
    if m.get('status') not in ALLOWED_MIGRATION_STATUS: raise err('link migration status not allowed')
    if count != AUTHORIZED_MIGRATION['link_count_after'] or digest != SUCCESSOR_EDGE_SHA256:
        raise err('edge set is not exactly the original 108 edges plus the authorized edge')
# --- end guard ---

def structures(data):
    records={x['id']:x for x in data['records']};obs={x['conclusion']:x for x in data['obligations']}
    imports={x['id']:x for x in data['imports']};corrections={x['id']:x for x in data['corrections']}
    local={x['id']:x for x in data['local_evidence']}
    if len(records)!=len(data['records']) or len(obs)!=len(data['obligations']):raise GateError('duplicate record or obligation')
    if set(records)!=set(obs):raise GateError('missing obligation for mathematical record')
    if len(imports)!=len(data['imports']) or len(corrections)!=len(data['corrections']) or len(local)!=len(data['local_evidence']):raise GateError('duplicate evidence/import/correction ID')
    return records,obs,imports,corrections,local

def fingerprints(data):
    records,obs,imports,corrections,local=structures(data)
    result={};active=set()
    def go(n):
        if n in active:raise GateError('cyclic proof graph')
        if n in result:return result[n]
        active.add(n)
        o=obs[n];parents=sorted(o['premises'])
        for p in parents:
            if p not in records:raise GateError('missing prerequisite '+p)
        blob={'record':records[n],
              'obligation':{k:v for k,v in o.items() if k!='fingerprint'},
              'premise_fingerprints':[[p,go(p)] for p in parents],
              'import_descriptors':[[i,imports[i]] for i in sorted(o['external_theorem_imports'])],
              'source_correction_descriptors':[[i,corrections[i]] for i in sorted(o['source_corrections'])],
              'local_check_descriptors':[[i,local[i]] for i in sorted(o['local_evidence_refs'])]}
        result[n]=digest(blob);active.remove(n);return result[n]
    for nid in sorted(records):go(nid)
    return result

def validate(data, require_stored_fingerprints=True):
    if data.get('schema_version')!='UL-obligation-certificate-v15.0':raise GateError('unexpected schema')
    records,obs,imports,corrections,local=structures(data)
    if len(records)!=104:raise GateError('original 104 records not preserved')
    if sum(r['project_acceptance']=='primary' for r in records.values())!=26:raise GateError('primary status change')
    if len(local)!=40:raise GateError('scoped-local inventory change')
    check_link_migration(data,obs,GateError)
    for r in records.values():
        if r['project_acceptance'] not in ACCEPT or r['proof_obligation_status'] not in PROOF or r['import_status'] not in IMPORT:raise GateError('unknown status axis')
        if not r['statement'] or not r['scope'] or not r['source']:raise GateError('missing statement, scope or source')
        if r['source_authenticated'] and not r.get('source_content_sha256'):raise GateError('claimed source authentication without bytes')
        if r['full_theorem_checker_passed'] or r['independently_reproduced_full_theorem']:raise GateError('unearned full theorem certification')
        if r['theorem_certificate_status']!='not_attached':raise GateError('full proof certificate has no verified artifact')
        if r['project_acceptance'] in {'refuted','candidate','excluded','conjecture'}:raise GateError('excluded mathematics admitted into mathematical core')
    for o in obs.values():
        n=o['conclusion']
        if o['id']!='OBL:'+n or not o['joint_premises_not_sufficient']:raise GateError('malformed obligation')
        if o['status'] not in PROOF or o['status']!='side_conditions_open':raise GateError('unjustified obligation promotion')
        if o['full_theorem_certificate_refs'] or o['full_proof_verified']:raise GateError('false full certificate')
        if not o['side_conditions'] or not all(x.get('text') for x in o['side_conditions']):raise GateError('missing explicit side condition')
        if not o['unlisted_side_conditions_possible']:raise GateError('unjustified assumption completeness')
        if not o['proof_bundle'].get('source'):raise GateError('missing source proof bundle')
        if len(o['premises'])!=len(set(o['premises'])) or n in o['premises']:raise GateError('duplicate or self prerequisite')
        if o['premises']!=sorted(o['premises']):raise GateError('noncanonical premise order')
        for pid in o['premises']:
            if pid not in records:raise GateError('missing premise: '+pid)
        for eid in o['external_theorem_imports']:
            if eid not in imports:raise GateError('missing external theorem import')
            if n not in imports[eid]['applies_to']:raise GateError('unsatisfied import scope: '+eid+' for '+n)
        for cid in o['source_corrections']:
            if cid not in corrections:raise GateError('missing mandatory source correction')
        for cid in o['local_evidence_refs']:
            if cid not in local or local[cid]['record_id']!=n:raise GateError('wrong scoped-local evidence linkage')
        if o['checker']['purpose']!='schema and mathematical dependency consistency only':raise GateError('checker scope misrepresented')
    for i in imports.values():
        if i['import_status'] not in IMPORT:raise GateError('import status invalid')
        if not i['scope_description'] or not i['statement_or_required_evidence']:raise GateError('import missing scope')
        if i['import_status'] in ('metadata_validated','scope_validated','independently_certified'):
            if not i.get('source_content_sha256') or not SHA.match(i['source_content_sha256']) or not i.get('source_version'):
                raise GateError('import metadata insufficient for validation')
            if not i['statement_match_checked'] or not i['source_bytes_authenticated']:
                raise GateError('import not pinned and statement aligned')
        if i['import_status'] in ('scope_validated','independently_certified') and not i['all_conditions_satisfied']:
            raise GateError('unsatisfied import scope')
        if i['import_status']=='independently_certified' and not i['independently_certified']:
            raise GateError('unbacked independent import certification')
        if any(r not in records for r in i['applies_to']):raise GateError('import targets missing record')
    for c in corrections.values():
        if c['authenticated'] and not c.get('source_content_sha256'):raise GateError('correction asserted authenticated without source hash')
        if c['validated'] and not c['authenticated']:raise GateError('correction untrusted')
    for c in local.values():
        if c['full_proof_certificate'] or c['checker_passed_for_full_statement'] or c['independent_full_proof_reproduction']:
            raise GateError('local evidence falsely promoted')
    for h in data['audit_history']:
        if h['admitted_to_core'] or h['project_acceptance'] not in ACCEPT:
            raise GateError('excluded/historical mathematics misclassified')
        if h['project_node_id'] in records:raise GateError('historical item linked into admitted core')
    actual=fingerprints(data)
    if require_stored_fingerprints:
        for n,f in actual.items():
            if obs[n].get('fingerprint')!=f:raise GateError('stale fingerprint: '+n)
    return {'result':'STRUCTURALLY_VALID_NOT_MATH_CERTIFIED','mathematical_records':len(records),
        'primary_status_listed':sum(r['project_acceptance']=='primary' for r in records.values()),
        'direct_source_explicit_links':sum(len(o['premises']) for o in obs.values()),
        'obligation_records':len(obs),'import_classes':len(imports),'correction_documents':len(corrections),
        'local_scoped_evidence_items':len(local),'full_theorem_certificates':0,
        'unvalidated_imports':sum(i['import_status']=='unvalidated' for i in imports.values()),
        'mathematical_source_bytes_authenticated':False,
        'dataset_sha256':hashlib.sha256(canonical(data)).hexdigest()}

def changed(data, section, item, field, value):
    dat=copy.deepcopy(data)
    mapping={'statement':'records','side_condition':'obligations','import':'imports','correction':'corrections','local_evidence':'local_evidence'}
    if section not in mapping:raise GateError('impact kind invalid')
    lst=dat[mapping[section]]
    def key(x):return x.get('conclusion') if section=='side_condition' else x.get('id')
    matching=[x for x in lst if key(x)==item]
    if len(matching)!=1:raise GateError('impact target not found')
    x=matching[0]
    if section=='statement':x['statement']=str(x['statement'])+' '+value
    elif section=='side_condition':x['side_conditions'][0]['text']+=' '+value
    elif section=='import':x['scope_description']+=' '+value
    elif section=='correction':x['role']+=' '+value
    elif section=='local_evidence':x['limits']+=' '+value
    old=fingerprints(data);new=fingerprints(dat)
    affected=sorted(n for n in old if old[n]!=new[n]);primary={x['id'] for x in data['records'] if x['project_acceptance']=='primary'}
    return {'changed_kind':section,'changed_item':item, 'affected_obligations':affected,
            'affected_primary_records':sorted(primary.intersection(affected)),'affected_count':len(affected),
            'note':'Impact of a hypothetical metadata change, not a mathematical contradiction.'}
